quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon opens new backend manufacturing hub in Thailand (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon officially inaugurated its new greenfield backend manufacturing site in Bangkok, Samut Prakan (Thailand), adding capacity and diversifying its manufacturing network alongside the ongoing expansion of its frontend capacities. The site covers the full spectrum of backend processes (cleanroom, assembly and test) as well as wafer test, serving automotive, industrial and energy infrastructure applications. Starting with Module A, it can scale up to five modules, giving it the potential to become one of Infineon's largest backend sites over time; it employs around 350 people, expected to grow to approximately 1,000 as Module A ramps up.
quarterly_data.figure: up to five modules; around 350 employees, growing to approximately 1,000
